The test is correct and is catching a real bug, so the test must not be changed.","action":"report","patch":null,"report":"The VAT calculation in public/cart.js is wrong. `vat()` uses `const taxable = subtotal(items);` but the documented rule is that VAT is charged after the discount. It should be `const taxable = subtotal(items) - discount(items);`. As a result, every order over 1000 is overcharged: on the 1398 basket in this test, VAT shows 294 instead of 264 and the total comes to 1552 instead of 1522 (an overcharge of 30). The fix belongs in the app, not the test. Leave tests/cart.spec.js:56 failing until the app is fixed. Two things for a human to confirm: (1) that rule 3 (VAT after discount) is still the intended rule, and (2) whether a release has already overcharged real customers.
